steps_pdf-decrypt_1Desc: Select a password-protected PDF. You must know the password to unlock it — there is no way to bypass encryption without the correct password.
steps_pdf-decrypt_2Desc: Type the document's password. The tool attempts to decrypt using this password. If successful, the PDF is unlocked instantly in your browser.
steps_pdf-decrypt_3Desc: Once decrypted, download the unlocked PDF. The file is now freely accessible without a password — store it securely if it contains sensitive information.
